🖥 Security chief: Iran firmly determined to break blockade 📌 Tehran, IRNA – Secretary of the Supreme National Security Council Mohsen Rezaei has stressed Iran’s firm determination to break the blockade. “[US President Donald] Trump and his defeated team’s plans to blockade Iran are as delusional and futile as their failed war strategy,” Rezaei wrote on his X account on Wednesday. ​ “The Iranian nation, armed forces, and the entire state apparatus remain firmly determined to break the blockade and respond with full force to any new aggression,” he added. ​ Earlier, Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi had said the US blockade was entirely unlawful, expressing hope that it would be lifted through a rational, logical approach. 📲 @Irna_en ​

The Yemeni Armed Forces' spokesperson announced two military operations against Saudi targets, saying they struck the Ras Tanura Refinery in the Eastern Province and the financial center in King Abdullah Economic City in Riyadh. In the statement, the spokesperson said the first operation caused "fires at the refinery," while the second was carried out in three phases and caused "extensive damage." According to the spokesperson, the two operations were in response to the ongoing Saudi aggression in Sanaa and across other Yemeni governorates, including attacks on passenger buses and civilian trucks in Al-Maqatirah District in Lahij Governorate. Vowing to "continue military operations deep inside Saudi territory," the Yemeni Armed Forces declared they would "enforce the equation of blockade for blockade and escalation for escalation," and continue "targeting Saudi troop buildups and officers until the aggression stops and the blockade on Yemen is lifted."
